item.title: Malibu Awards $415,000 in Grants for Education, Wildfire Preparedness
item.description: The Malibu City Council has approved $415,000 in General Fund grants to two nonprofit organizations, with $315,000 going to the Malibu Education Foundation and $100,000 to the Community Brigade for emergency preparedness.

item.title: Flash floods impact ongoing work in burn zones
item.description: Flash floods from Monday's storms caused mudslides on Topanga Canyon Boulevard and Pacific Coast Highway in Palisades Fire burn areas, closing roads.

item.title: School district prepares for layoffs of janitors and reading aides
item.description: Santa Monica-Malibu Unified School District will lay off 27+ employees including reading teachers and custodians at end of 2025-26 school year amid union disputes.

item.title: Caltrans asks for input on extending bus-only lanes along Lincoln
item.description: Caltrans is asking for public feedback until April 17 on extending bus lanes on Lincoln Boulevard through Los Angeles from Venice to Manchester.

item.title: County Board Advances Disaster Recovery Rebuild Authority
item.description: Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors approves Disaster Recovery Rebuild Authority for Santa Monica Mountains and Altadena after 2025 wildfires.

item.title: NFL, LA28 Unveil Flag Football Olympic Emblem During Super Bowl Broadcast
item.description: NFL and LA28 revealed flag football's official Olympic emblem during Super Bowl broadcast, marking the sport's 2028 Los Angeles Olympics debut.

item.title: LA Health Services Reports Record Care Delivery Despite Budget Challenges
item.description: LA County Health Services delivered 2.9 million patient visits and served 480,000 patients in 2025 despite budget challenges across 4 hospitals and 23 clinics.

item.title: Concrete panels clog Santa Monica Channel after the storm
item.description: Los Angeles Councilwoman Tracy Park took to Instagram this week to update residents on a strange sight just north of Santa Monica where concrete slabs had fallen into the storm drain. She said crews would work to clear the area when it was safe to do so. View this post
